title: Typed intent and deterministic interconnect plans
summary: Bound agent-facing design actions to explicit schemas, dependency ordering and live backend capabilities.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Implemented typed design intent, strict operation schemas and deterministic compilation into dependency-ordered interconnect plans.
Bound discovery to live Configuration Engine capabilities and source evidence, explicitly separating certified, assisted-only, unsupported and externally gated behavior.

notes: A bounded engineering plan compiler is not a claim to have authored a general-purpose model/tool execution loop.
